title: South Korea's Incheon airport becomes world's busiest for global traffic
facts: Incheon International Airport in South Korea became the world's busiest airport by international passenger traffic.
Incheon International Airport handled 38.4 million international passengers during the first six months of 2026.
Airports Council International published preliminary global airport traffic data for the first half of 2026.
London Heathrow Airport ranked second in global passenger traffic with 37.79 million international passengers.
Singapore's Changi Airport ranked third worldwide with 34.53 million international passengers.
Incheon airport attributed its traffic growth partly to flight diversions away from Middle Eastern hubs due to the US-Iran war.
Dubai International Airport had ranked second globally in international passenger traffic in both 2024 and 2025.
London Heathrow Airport ranked fifth globally in 2024 and seventh in 2025.
Incheon International Airport ranked 12th in international passenger traffic in 2024 and 13th in 2025.
Transfer passengers at Incheon Airport increased by 18% compared to the same period in the previous year.
The volume of transfer passengers at Incheon traveling to European destinations increased by 63.2% to 210,000.
Incheon International Airport originally commenced operations in 2001.
Incheon International Airport provides flight connections to 158 international destinations.
Hong Kong International Airport serves 139 international flight destinations.
Kim Beom-ho serves as the acting president of the Incheon International Airport Corporation.
